Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-maintenance.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Add the exact first-row refusal order assertion B then C to the existing many-error workbook court. Retain the 260 total/100 retained bounds and original reader behavior; this is the accepted follow-up after the landed bounded-reader slice.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

From Claude independent review of bd-01M37D6APTEQTVVSMSC195Z184 at SHA 195e83f2 (Fray #110 seq952). Existing synthetic many-error workbook proves exact total 260 and first 100 retained but only asserts refusal columns as a set. Add a within-row order assertion for the first two diagnostics, expected B then C, without changing the reviewed bounded-reader slice. Do after that slice lands; this is FOLLOW-UP, not a landing block.
